Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate, for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. Siddhartha Jain, Advocate, for the 
respondent. 
In the instant Writ Petition, the Coordinate 
Bench of this Court on 24th September, 2020, had 
granted time to the respondent to file counter 
affidavit. 
There is office report of 30th November, 
2021, that no counter affidavit has been filed till 
date, despite of expiry of more than one year from 
the date of passing of the order. 
Learned counsel for the respondent submits 
that the counter affidavit is ready and he would be 
filing the same within two weeks. 
The said permission is granted, but subject 
to the condition that the respondent deposits a cost 
of Rs.1,000/- in the High Court Bar Association 
Advocate Welfare Fund. 
List immediately after two weeks.

1. Mr. M.S. Tyagi, learned Senior Advocate 
assisted by Mr. Brahm Dev, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.

respondent.
3. The petitioner was terminated from service 
after holding the full fledged disciplinary 
proceedings. The chargesheet was given and 
thereafter the inquiry report was submitted. In the 
inquiry report there is reference of certain exhibits in 
reference to the each of the charges. The petitioner 
obtains the information through RTI in 2018, and as 
per the RTI information there is a reference that 
there is no record of any information/complaint of 
any member of the staff.
4 Let the original record relating to a 
disciplinary proceedings of the petitioner be placed 
before this Court.
5. Put up this case on 08.10.2025.
